subject: Seed credits + slot reservation — pricing & multi-year incentive options
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara@nimbuslabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex+procure@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pricing targets and startup credit interest

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can evaluate economics with the exec team: 

- Expected monthly token demand: ~350M tokens (peak month) with steady-state 120M–180M tokens/month thereafter.
- Runway / budget range for inference: ~$12k–$30k/month initially (seed round constraints, CFO needs a low-end anchor).
- Target cost goal: ideally under $900 per 1M tokens for the initial model path (combination of quantized Llama-family).

We are very interested in the Seed Program / startup credits you mentioned. Specifically: is there a simple path for a 6–12 month committed discount that combines an upfront credit and a smaller committed monthly minimum? Also curious if Redwood can reserve a slot for capacity (predictable latency) — we have a hard SLO for demo day in Q1 that would benefit from reserved capacity.

Attaching our rough token burn estimate. Can you and your team confirm which discount tiers we realistically qualify for and a sample committed-use structure (e.g., $X/month guarantee + Y% off vs list)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up this week.

—Sara
Sara Lopez
Head of ML Platforms | Nimbus Labs
[sent from mobile]

[Attachment: nimbus_estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex+procure@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing targets and startup credit interest

Sara — great to meet earlier, appreciate the clear numbers. Quick internal recap and asks so we can produce an exact quote: 

1) Qualification: Based on the token profiles you shared, you fall squarely into our Seed Program for early-stage startups (we bundle a base credit + stepped discounts). I'll attach the Seed Program one-pager so you can share with finance.

2) Sample economics (very rough, ballpark):
   - No commitment / pay-as-you-go: ~$1,200 per 1M tokens (quantized path)
   - 6mo committed minimum (reserve 60M tokens/mo): target $950 per 1M tokens + $10k signup credit (subject to deal review)
   - 12mo committed minimum (reserve 100M tokens/mo): target $750 per 1M tokens + $20k credit + capacity reservation option

Those are placeholders — I want to validate with Marissa (pricing) and Ben (rev ops) before we lock. Two asks: can you confirm whether the 350M peak is expected inside a single month (demo spike) or across multiple bursts? And confirm whether Nimbus can commit to a 6 vs 12 month minimum today for planning.

I'll loop Marissa and Ben; Marissa will share the program doc and a proposed tiered term sheet. Ben will outline procurement timeline and what we need for slot reservation. If you want a short call, we can do Wed 9:30 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of GTM | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-startup-program.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@nimbuslabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex+procure@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing targets and startup credit interest

Hi Sara — thanks for the estimate, and Karthik thanks for the framing. Attached is a draft term sheet that maps the tiers to concrete numbers. Highlights: 

- Seed Tier A (6mo): 60M tokens/month committed, $925 per 1M tokens effective, $12k credit applied at invoice 1.
- Seed Tier B (12mo): 100M tokens/month committed, $700 per 1M tokens effective, $25k credit + optional capacity reservation (regional GPU pool) for $1,500/month.
- Multi-year additive: for 24mo structures we can layer an additional 5% off effective price after year 1 if baseline volumes are met.

We built in a slot-reservation line item — Ben, can you confirm lead time to reserve the regional pool?

Sara, if those ranges look reasonable I can convert the draft into a commercial term sheet and send to procurement + legal for quick review. If you prefer, we can also show a blended forecast that maps your 350M peak into burst/capacity pricing so finance can see worst-case.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Pricing | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: draft-commitment-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@nimbuslabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing targets and startup credit interest

Quick operational next steps / procurement checklist — Sara / Alex, copying required items so we can progress to a signature-ready doc: 

1) Confirm chosen commitment: SELECT one — 6mo @ 60M/mo (Seed A) or 12mo @ 100M/mo (Seed B)
2) Provide PO or purchase intent email from Nimbus finance (Alex is fine to start a PO thread).
3) Provide legal point of contact for a standard MSA + SOW (we have a SKU for capacity reservation).
4) Once (1–3) are in, we will: a) lock pricing and credits; b) generate DocuSign packet; c) provision regional capacity slot (lead time ~2–3 weeks after signature).

Tentative timeline if Nimbus signs by 09/24: provisioned capacity + credits applied by 10/10 to support Q1 demo load testing. Link to DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ds-example-NIM-2027-081

If Sara/ Alex can confirm (1) today, I'll push the DocuSign packet and copy legal. Happy to hop on a quick call with Alex to walk procurement through the PO fields.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
